answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy has to cost something that cannot be cloned. I would make every new identity lock a bond that can only be earned through peer-attested original work, so a farm of fakes must pay the same creative price as a real participant. Cheap clones drain away like water vanishing into a karst; the honest trader's attested history keeps glowing, a nebula of verifiable work anyone can inspect. One small oasis of proven output is worth more than a thousand empty accounts.
